files_modified.behavior_before: inferRestAuth() only handled 3 literal string cases: null→'none', '__return_true'→'none', 'is_user_logged_in'→'subscriber'. Closure permission_callbacks resolved to 'unknown'.
files_modified.behavior_after: parseRouteConfig() now stores permission_callback_ast (AST node) in addition to the string sentinel. inferRestAuth() detects Closure/ArrowFunction AST node and calls analyzePermissionCallbackBody(). That method scans for current_user_can('manage_options'|'administrator') → 'admin', current_user_can('edit_posts'|'publish_posts') → 'author', current_user_can(any other cap) or is_user_logged_in() → 'subscriber', unconditional return true → 'none', else → 'unknown'.

functions_changed: collectDeclarations (visitor extended with Trait_, TraitUse, traitMethods handling)
files_modified.behavior_before: collectDeclarations() ignored Node\Stmt\Trait_ and Node\Stmt\TraitUse. findMethod('ClassName', 'traitMethod') returned null when method was defined in a trait.
files_modified.behavior_after: Visitor collects Trait_ methods into visitor->traitMethods[]. After each file, trait methods are merged into SymbolTable->traitMethods[] global registry. TraitUse inside a class stores trait names in class['trait_uses'] and aliasing info in class['trait_aliases']. After ALL files processed, resolveTraitUses() does a post-pass: merges trait methods into each class's method table (own methods take precedence). Cross-file trait→class resolution works correctly. findMethod() is unchanged and now returns trait methods transparently.

deviations_from_spec.actual: Deferred trait-into-class merging to a post-processing resolveTraitUses() pass in build(). Reason: if trait declared in file A and class uses it in file B, the per-file visitor's leaveNode would not have the trait methods available. Post-pass uses the global $this->traitMethods registry that accumulates across all files.
deviations_from_spec.risk: NONE — behavior is equivalent for same-file traits (still works), and correct for cross-file traits (now works). Source_ref (gap-analysis-final.md:775-778) does not specify whether same-file or cross-file resolution is required.

deviations_from_spec.actual: For aliases with unknown source trait (Alias adaptation without trait qualifier), fall back to first trait in trait_uses list at collection time. Edge case: if alias source is ambiguous and trait declared after class, alias may not resolve. Risk is LOW — WP plugins almost never use ambiguous trait aliasing.
